[ASSISTANT_SAID] The process of combining images is called "image compositing" or "image blending."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Image segmentation is a technique used to separate pixels of an image into different regions based on color, texture, or other visual cues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended software for image compositing includes Adobe Photoshop or GIMP.
